title: AI Engineer — Automation & Internal Systems
description: nyra health builds the digital tools that make neurological rehabilitation work inside and outside clinic walls: myReha, the patient therapy app, and nyra insights, the clinician platform. 100+ clinics, 100K+ patients across DACH. 3× MRR growth target for 2026. €20M Series A. Scaling the team to around 50 this year. Ownership, excellence and patients first — that’s how we drive progress together.We’re well on our way to becoming AI-native, but there is still so much more we can do with work automation. You’ll help us unlock it, one workflow at a time.Our ambition is company as code: our processes live as code, our agents do the repetitive work, and every colleague knows how to work with AI. Together with our AI Automation team, you’ll make that real across the company.We’re hiring an AI Engineer to join our AI Automation team. You’ll build the workflows, agents and internal systems that help colleagues work more effectively. The role combines process design, hands-on automation and the cloud and data foundations that make those systems reliable.You’ll shape the automation roadmap: you find where time is lost, decide what’s worth building, and ship it into daily use. You’ll work directly with colleagues across commercial, operations, product, clinical, finance and people.What you’ll work onUnderstand and improve how nyra worksMap how teams work: their processes, systems, responsibilities and handoffs. Build a shared process map that colleagues can use and keep up to date.Find improvements and automation opportunities, and agree on priorities, scope and expected benefits with the people doing the work.Build automations people can rely onBuild and ship workflows, integrations and internal tools with AI coding agents as your default. Guide agents with clear context and reusable skills, review their changes, and verify results through tests and evaluations.Own rollout and reliable operation, including cloud infrastructure, deployments, access controls, monitoring and recovery when something fails. Choose the right mix of AI, conventional integrations and process changes for each problem.Help colleagues work well with AITurn proven AI-assisted workflows into reusable agent skills, practical examples and documentation that colleagues can use in their daily work.Help technical and non-technical colleagues adopt AI through hands-on support, demos and short workshops. Evaluate what improves speed, quality or reliability and share what works.What you bringAI-native development: Coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar) are already your default way of building, and you can show us what you’ve shipped this way. You know how to structure tasks, supply the right context and tools, and evaluate and improve the results.Engineering judgment: You understand code, system design and data flows, can assess changes generated by AI, and can investigate failures across connected systems. You are comfortable working with Python or TypeScript.Production delivery: You’ve shipped and maintained automations, integrations or internal tools that people use. You can deploy them and keep them reliable through testing, monitoring and failure handling.Cloud & infrastructure: You have hands-on experience deploying and operating systems on Google Cloud (GCP) or a comparable cloud platform. You understand how cloud services, networking and access permissions fit together, and can troubleshoot infrastructure issues.Self-starter with impact focus: You spot problems before anyone files a ticket and can tell which ones are worth solving. You’ve taken tools or automations from your own idea to daily use, saving people real time or effort.Clear communication: You enjoy working with technical and non-technical colleagues, understanding their work and sharing practical ways to improve it.Nice to haveExperience in healthtech or another regulated environment.Experience building internal systems in a growing startup as teams, tools and responsibilities change.Why nyra?Build nyra’s internal operating system: Shape how teams work, from choosing worthwhile problems to building tools colleagues use every day.Patients first, always: We build for better patient outcomes. Your work gives our teams more time to focus on the people delivering and receiving rehabilitation.Ownership & direct access: See the impact of your work and take responsibility for outcomes. Founders, ML engineers and practicing clinicians work closely together, so decisions move fast and you’re part of them.Transparent, direct culture: Open communication and honest feedback are how we operate.AI-native: Every team member has Claude Pro and is expected to use AI tools daily.Some of the best Mario Kart drivers in the Austrian startup scene 😉The processIntro call, around 30 minutes: Talk about your background, expectations, nyra and the role.Practical technical conversation with our Automation team and engineering colleagues: Walk us through a project you’ve built. Discuss its design, implementation, cloud setup, reliability and tradeoffs, and explore a workflow or integration problem together.Meet the founders: Discuss how you approach problems, collaborate across teams and help nyra improve its operations as the company grows. title: Senior Global Data AI Specialist
description: At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.Senior Operation Manager for D&AMission of the Role Do you enjoy turning real business challenges into working AI solutions? Would you like to do it at a global company that is changing its industry with new technology? ABB is looking for a hands-on AI/ML Engineer to join our Information Systems (IS).This is a specialist role where you build the solutions yourself. It is not a coordination or management role. You will work with the business to understand its needs and then find the best answer. That could be a predictive model, an LLM or SLM, an AI agent, a GenAI application, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. You will take that solution from idea to production and keep it running well in operations.If you have experience with Azure AI/ML, Snowflake, GenAI and MLOps, and you want to own solutions from start to finish across both Dev and Ops, this opportunity is for you!Work model: HybridResponsibilitiesBusiness understanding and solution design Work with business stakeholders and Data Analysts to clarify needs, requirements, expected outcomes, success measures, data and context requirements, risks and ownership. Decide which approach fits each business problem best: AI/ML, GenAI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. This includes choosing the right model type (ML, LLM, SLM), the right agent design and the right technology. Design scalable solutions that follow enterprise architecture, security and governance standards, with guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and platform architects. Build and deploy Develop, validate and deploy production-ready AI/ML solutions using Python, SQL, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry and other approved technologies. Build ML and GenAI applications, including predictive models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, AI agents, APIs, orchestration, retrieval and enterprise data integrations. Build and integrate LLM-based solutions and conversational agents using Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI and, where appropriate, Copilot Studio and Power Platform. Support Copilot and other AI platforms, such as Anthropic models. Use enterprise data from SAP and Salesforce to build predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents that deliver measurable business value. Build secure, reliable data ingestion and processing from Snowflake and other enterprise sources, with attention to data quality, lineage, access control and cost efficiency. Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities, including Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions. Develop reusable components and automated pipelines for data preparation, feature engineering, training, inference, evaluation, testing, deployment and retraining, using CI/CD and version control. Evaluate, operate and improve (DevOps / MLOps / AIOps) Evaluate model accuracy, explainability, grounding, agent behaviour, safety, business value, performance, reliability and cost. Set up and run MLOps/AIOps practices: monitoring, drift detection, cost monitoring, root-cause analysis, retraining and continuous improvement. You own both development and operations. Contribute to production readiness, operational handover, incident and problem analysis, monitoring design and reliable day-to-day operations. Apply Responsible AI, information security, privacy, compliance, identity and access management, secrets management and other ABB requirements within your solution scope.Ownership and collaboration Own your deliverables end to end. Estimate effort, manage priorities, report progress and risks, and work independently within the agreed architecture and platform guardrails. Work closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, platform specialists and domain experts. Document solution logic, assumptions, limitations, evaluation results and operational requirements. Contribute reusable assets, engineering practices, knowledge sharing and mentoring.RequirementsEducation and experience Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, analytics engineering or related roles, including taking AI/ML solutions to production. Experience delivering AI/ML solutions end to end: business requirements, data preparation, development, validation, deployment and monitoring. Technical SkillsPractical Python and SQL skills for data preparation, model development, API integration, testing and implementation. Hands-on experience with Azure Machine Learning and Microsoft Foundry: pipelines, compute, environments, model deployment, endpoints, agents and evaluation. Strong understanding of GenAI patterns: LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, agent design and evaluation. Working knowledge of ML and statistics: supervised and unsupervised learning, model validation, regression, time series and hypothesis testing. Experience with ML frameworks such as Scikit-learn and, where relevant, XGBoost, PyTorch or TensorFlow. Experience with automated pipelines and CI/CD, using version control and testing practices, preferably in Azure DevOps or GitHub. Hands-on experience with Snowflake AI/ML tools (Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, AI Functions) and Snowflake connectors. Experience analysing, modelling and integrating SAP and Salesforce data. This means understanding source data structures, business entities, relationships and transformation requirements.Operations and governance Understanding of how AI/ML solutions run in production: monitoring, reliability, performance, cost management, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement. Working knowledge of enterprise architecture, cloud security, privacy, compliance, data governance and Responsible AI principles.Communication and language Ability to turn business needs into technical solutions, explain options and trade-offs, and communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders. Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1).Nice to Have / Differentiators Experience with LLM frameworks such as the Azure OpenAI SDK, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or equivalent. Experience with other AI platforms and models (e.g., Anthropic, SLMs). Microsoft certifications: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100) or Machine Learning Operations Engineer Associate (AI-300). Snowflake certifications, such as SnowPro Core or relevant GenAI certifications. Experience using Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting. Experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Streamlit or other data visualisation tools. Knowledge of Azure infrastructure for AI/ML workloads: networking, VNets/private endpoints, Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, storage, containers, Azure Monitor and Application Insights. Infrastructure as Code experience (Bicep or Terraform). Experience mentoring colleagues or contributing to shared engineering standards and reusable assets.What We OfferThe chance to be part of a global company working on high-impact industrial projects. A collaborative environment with continuous learning, advanced technologies and a strong development culture. Room to grow on a solid technical career path at ABB.Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.Recruitment Fraud WarningABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/homeFor more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning Show more Show less
